stem.text: The graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the velocity of a vehicle moving in a straight line.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity in m s^-1 against time t in s, from 0 to 7 s, with plotted points and a curve.

stem.text: The vehicle, moving at $4.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$, begins to accelerate at time $t = 0$.
What is the vehicle's acceleration at time $t = 3.0\,\text{s}$?
